title: HIV and AIDS: Symptoms by Stage, How It Spreads, and Free Testing and Treatment in India
seoTitle: HIV AIDS Symptoms, Causes, Testing and Treatment in India
seoDescription: HIV symptoms by stage, how HIV spreads and doesn't, HIV vs AIDS, free tests at ICTCs, the 28-day window period, PEP within 72 hours and free ART in India.
excerpt: What each stage of HIV looks like, what does and doesn't spread it, where to get a free confidential test, why U=U matters, and the legal rights people living with HIV have in India.
